description: Reverse-image search via Google Lens for visual matches and products.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code to geo-target results (e.g. us, gb, in, de). (API default: us)

language.description: Result language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de). (API default: en)

query.description: Optional text query to run alongside the image.

url.description: URL of the image to run through Google Lens.

name: google_lens
title: Google Lens API
